rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing something as orange-coloured.

example.english: I want to buy the orange shirt.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 caang2 sik1 go2 gin6 saam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the orange fruit.

example.english: I bought an orange to eat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 caang2 sik6

rows.note: Use 橙色 specifically for the orange colour rather than the fruit.

example.english: This wall is painted orange, so it really stands out.
example.traditional: 呢幅牆油咗橙色，幾搶眼喎。
example.jyutping: nei1 fuk1 coeng4 jau4 zo2 caang2 sik1 gei2 coeng2 ngaan5 wo3

rows.note: Use 橙樹 specifically when referring to the orange tree rather than its fruit.

example.english: We planted an orange tree in the backyard.
example.traditional: 我哋喺後園種咗棵橙樹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hau6 jyun4 zung3 zo2 fo2 caang2 syu6
